subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class project/thread organization to the core Control UI now, and what Gateway/session transcript semantics should route targets, split/move, and seed-copy expose?
rationale: The remaining work changes user-facing organization, persisted session metadata, transcript movement or copy semantics, and Gateway protocol shape, so automation cannot choose the durable product contract safely.

options.title: Define core product/API first
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to session organization
options.body: Limit near-term work to labels, search, pinning, archiving, and possibly grouping over existing sessions without transcript mutation or composer fanout.

options.title: Defer broader workflow
options.body: Do not add core project/thread semantics now; rely on current flat session management, reply quotes, and checkpoint branching until stronger demand or a narrower API proposal appears.

recommendation.title: Define core product/API first
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and authored the adjacent session-thread management work now on main.
